description: This file defines the RequestyHandler class, a provider for handling API requests to the Requesty service, including model fetching, message creation, and usage metrics processing.

classes.name: RequestyHandler
classes.description: A class that manages interactions with the Requesty API, including model management, message streaming, and usage tracking.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches and caches available models from the Requesty API.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration, merging defaults and applying preferences.

methods.name: processUsageMetrics
methods.description: Processes usage data to compute token counts and costs.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat completion message, handling streaming responses and tool calls.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Generates a complete response for a given prompt without streaming.
